ex.en: Tom puts gas in his car twice a week.
ex.zh: 湯姆每週替車子加兩次油。

ex.en: Even a broken clock is right twice a day.
ex.zh: 就連壞掉的時鐘，一天也會準兩次。

ex.en: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
ex.zh: 這條隧道的長度是那條的兩倍。

ex.en: Smokers take twice as many days off sick as non-smokers.
ex.zh: 吸菸者請病假的天數是不吸菸者的兩倍。

twice.en: two times as much or as many

ex.en: Those twins look like two peas in a pod.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎長得一模一樣。

ex.en: We could not tell the twins one from the other.
ex.zh: 我們分不出那對雙胞胎誰是誰。

twin.en: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time

ex.en: He mistook me for my twin brother.
ex.zh: 他把我誤認成我的雙胞胎兄弟。

ex.en: His wife gave birth to twin boys.
ex.zh: 他太太生了一對雙胞胎男孩。

twin.en: born at the same time as a brother or sister

ex.en: I'd like to book a twin room, please.
ex.zh: 我想訂一間雙床房。

ex.en: The plane has twin engines.
ex.zh: 這架飛機有兩具引擎。

twin.en: made up of two similar things, or having two single beds

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
ex.zh: 她運動時扭傷了腳踝。

ex.en: I twisted my knee playing basketball.
ex.zh: 我打籃球時扭傷了膝蓋。

twist.en: to hurt a part of the body by turning it suddenly in the wrong way

ex.en: Don't twist my words around.
ex.zh: 不要扭曲我說的話。

ex.en: The media twisted his comments.
ex.zh: 媒體扭曲了他的發言。

twist.en: to change the meaning of something so that it is no longer true

ex.en: Twist the cap to open the bottle.
ex.zh: 轉開瓶蓋來打開瓶子。

ex.en: She twisted the lid off the jar.
ex.zh: 她把罐子的蓋子轉開。

twist.en: to turn something around with your hand

ex.en: The story has a surprising twist at the end.
ex.zh: 這個故事的結局有出人意料的轉折。

ex.en: In a strange twist, the two rivals became partners.
ex.zh: 出乎意料地，兩個對手竟成了合作夥伴。

twist.en: an unexpected change in a story or situation

ex.en: I have two brothers and one sister.
ex.zh: 我有兩個哥哥（弟弟）和一個姊姊（妹妹）。

ex.en: The meeting starts at two.
ex.zh: 會議兩點開始。

ex.en: Two of my friends are coming to dinner.
ex.zh: 我有兩位朋友要來吃晚餐。

ex.en: There are twenty students in the classroom.
ex.zh: 教室裡有二十個學生。

ex.en: I will be there in twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 我二十分鐘後到那裡。

ex.en: My grandmother gave me twenty dollars for my birthday.
ex.zh: 奶奶在我生日時給了我二十元。

ex.en: There are twelve months in a year.
ex.zh: 一年有十二個月。

ex.en: The meeting starts at twelve o'clock sharp.
ex.zh: 會議十二點整開始。

ex.en: I bought a box of twelve eggs at the market.
ex.zh: 我在市場買了一盒十二顆的雞蛋。

ex.en: Today is the twentieth of the month.
ex.zh: 今天是這個月的二十號。

ex.en: They are celebrating their twentieth anniversary this year.
ex.zh: 他們今年慶祝結婚二十週年。

ex.en: He finished in twentieth place in the race.
ex.zh: 他在比賽中得到第二十名。

ex.en: My birthday is on the twelfth of June.
ex.zh: 我的生日是六月十二日。

ex.en: She finished twelfth in the race.
ex.zh: 她在比賽中得了第十二名。

ex.en: The meeting will be held on the twelfth floor.
ex.zh: 會議將在十二樓舉行。

ex.en: A twelfth of the cake was left on the plate.
ex.zh: 盤子上剩下蛋糕的十二分之一。

ex.en: One twelfth of the class walked to school.
ex.zh: 班上有十二分之一的人步行上學。

ex.en: We sat on the porch and watched the twilight fade.
ex.zh: 我們坐在門廊上看著暮色漸漸消逝。

ex.en: Bats begin to fly at twilight.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠在黃昏時開始飛行。

ex.en: The old tree had a twisted trunk.
ex.zh: 那棵老樹的樹幹彎彎曲曲。

ex.en: The wreck was a mass of twisted metal.
ex.zh: 殘骸是一堆扭曲變形的金屬。

ex.en: The movie is about a twisted villain with a cruel sense of humor.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一個心理扭曲、幽默感殘酷的壞人。

ex.en: He has a twisted way of looking at the world.
ex.zh: 他看待世界的方式很扭曲。

twisted.zh: 扭傷、扭轉（twist 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while running down the stairs.
ex.zh: 她跑下樓梯時扭傷了腳踝。

ex.en: He twisted the cap off the bottle.
ex.zh: 他把瓶蓋扭開。

ex.en: The bird built its nest out of small twigs.
ex.zh: 那隻鳥用小樹枝築巢。

ex.en: He snapped a twig and threw it into the fire.
ex.zh: 他折斷一根小樹枝丟進火裡。

ex.en: It took me a while to twig what she meant.
ex.zh: 我過了好一會兒才搞懂她的意思。

ex.en: Then he twigged that it was a joke.
ex.zh: 接著他才領悟那是個玩笑。

ex.en: He wore an old tweed jacket with leather patches.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件有皮革補丁的舊粗花呢外套。

ex.en: Tweed is warm and often used for winter coats.
ex.zh: 粗花呢很保暖，常用來做冬季外套。

ex.en: His eye started to twitch when he was tired.
ex.zh: 他累的時候眼睛會開始抽動。

ex.en: The rabbit's nose twitched as it smelled the carrot.
ex.zh: 兔子聞到紅蘿蔔時鼻子抽動了起來。

ex.en: She felt a sudden twitch in her left leg.
ex.zh: 她的左腿突然抽了一下。

ex.en: A nervous twitch of his mouth showed he was lying.
ex.zh: 他嘴角緊張地抽動，顯示他在說謊。
